ITEM 1 | Mound of brown-and-tan grain mixture with visible yellow corn kernels and small dark specks, loose and fluffy with separate grains, dry matte surface, covering the left third of the plate in a roughly 12 cm by 11 cm footprint, about 3 cm tall | 180
ITEM 2 | Pale golden-cream pieces of cooked fish or poultry-like flesh with flaky, slightly glossy edges and light caramel browning in spots, cut into irregular chunks about 4 to 6 cm long, sitting on the right-center of the plate, about 1.5 to 2 cm thick | 150
ITEM 3 | Bright green wilted leafy greens, thin stems and ruffled leaves with a slightly glossy, moist sheen, scattered across and between the grain and fish, spanning about 10 cm, about 1 cm deep in clumps | 40
ITEM 4 | Small orange-red flecks and bits of diced vegetable with a glossy, lightly oily coating, scattered among the fish and greens, a few teaspoons' worth in total | 10
ITEM 5 | Thin smear of translucent, slightly oily sauce or pan juices with light sheen pooling in small patches around the fish and greens on the plate surface | 8
